question_text: Explain one availability benefit of a cloud application whose data and service replicas run in several geographic regions, compared with one on-premises server. Assume failover is configured and replicas are kept consistent enough for the application.
adaptation_rationale: Retain distribution of service resources; do not imply cloud necessarily removes central ownership. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: A failure affecting one region need not stop the entire service because another region has the data and running service needed to take over. This reduces dependence on one physical site, though it does not eliminate all common software or provider failures.

marking_points.criterion: Explains alternate site can take over after regional failure.
Links distribution to reduced single-site outage dependence with stated failover assumption.
